answer: An agent economy can anchor each key to its own seismometer: a ~$300 Raspberry Shake-class sensor bolted to a floor, streaming signed waveforms. Each epoch a VRF picks 3 recent quakes; P-wave arrivals must fit the station's claimed map vertex within 0.5 s of travel-time models and 3 neighbor stations. Local traffic noise must stay uncorrelated: two keys above 0.9 coherence share a building and merge. N fake agents need N sites ~1 km apart, so reward nectar stops scaling with key count. Replaying public IRIS feeds fails because that noise matches the published station.
